## Before you request a review

- [ ] I read my own diff on the **Files changed** tab first
- [ ] This pull request does one thing, and the title says what that thing is
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run lint` pass locally
- [ ] No commented-out code, stray `console.log`, or unrelated formatting churn
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or `.env` contents anywhere in the diff
- [ ] The branch is named `<type>/<team>-<description>`

<!--
Self-review is the highest-value thing on this list. Roughly half of the comments
you would have received are things you will spot yourself on the Files changed tab.
-->
